title: Save Rob
tagline: Save Rob is an app to save Video content creators from having their video scraped and monetized by AI
description:
This project breaks down on device AI modeling and saves it separately using decentralised nodes.

For users seeking a more personalized learning experience, a premium subscription model allows access to advanced AI models that compare the user's technique against that of the content creator. The subscription fees collected are distributed to content creators based on the popularity and utility of their videos, all managed through a smart contract deployed on the Base testnet.

This app combines video sharing, AI analysis, and blockchain technology to create an engaging and rewarding learning environment.
how_its_made: The application is a platform designed for content creators and learners, enabling users to upload instructional videos and access AI-driven learning tools. Content creators, like Alice, can record and upload videos demonstrating various skills, such as tying a tie knot. These videos, along with associated AI modeling data, are stored on Nillion Decentralised nodes, ensuring secure and decentralized access.
